title: Photos of him at 19 and the Montreal show
summary: Pictures of him as a young cornetist, a Montreal theatre show for J.C. Stewart, and a Mitchell Grove photo of 1907.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: These are the pictures. Let's see. That's a good picture.
This is the one. That's the old-time coronet. This is your husband.
Oh, yeah. He's holding his little shark coronet. Look at that. See? He was quite young there. He looks like about 20 years old actually, doesn't he?
And this is the one. I told you about him in unicorns. That's right. He's in the sun. He's playing trouble too. Oh, yes.
This is an owl here. This is sitting there. Right where?

Right here. I can't see him at the night right now. Who can see him? Can you find Sidney out there? That's Rose right there. Oh, yes. Right by the... I think that's right there. I see him here. That's Rose. I know Rose.
He's standing second to the... Last. Oh, last on the end on the right. See the earphones they have? Oh, yes. It's not sure.
It looks like a parman's uniform.

That says Montreal, Canada, Premier Theatre, November 26, 19 and 7. And tonight the two Johns. I guess that's a show or something else. Yes. Some other act. Can you read any more of that, Ralph, on there? Yeah. We'll read what it says on the drum.
It says the Nation's Big Revival of J.C. Stewart's. Let me see. There's a sign on the back that says positively. Oh, no smoking in this room. I couldn't read it very good.
This one says Mitchell Grove, Sunday, August the 4th, 1907. There he is again, right here, in a different uniform.
